summary: Preserve explicit anonymous public Travel command wiring, exact dated offer identity, per-room whole-stay quote units, bounded coverage, and live/cache provenance.
reason: Public HTML plan pages contain multiple room tuples per source plan, with explicit uniform per-room party and query echoes; generic endpoint output and compact filtering can erase quote units or silently substitute an offer. Reprints must retain bounded comparisons, exact inspection with separately scoped policies, and stderr-only warnings for optional cache write failures so valid remote observations remain usable.
validated_outcome: CLI tests use the real domain client with injected HTTP transport: 105 source-page rows require one inventory fetch plus two property fetches, prices/IDs survive agent and dotted selection, and empty/error comparison cells retain distinct status. Blocked-cache regressions preserve valid live JSON across all focused leaves, keep warnings on stderr and --no-cache silent, and retain upstream failures as errors. Explicit constructor bindings expose the runtime command tree; live semantic assertions supplement the workflow runner.
